title: Sonilo SFX
summary: Generate sound effect with Sonilo SFX
description: Sonilo text-to-sound-effect — Foley, ambience, UI sounds, transitions, impacts and action effects from a short description, 1-180 seconds long. Priced per second of the requested duration with a 3-second minimum (see GET /v1/models for the rate; POST /v1/cost quotes the exact price). MP3 or WAV output.

duration.description: Length of the effect in seconds (1-180). Billed per second with a 3-second minimum.

prompt.description: Description of the sound effect (up to 1000 characters), e.g. "heavy rain on a tin roof with distant thunder".
